title: Director, Operations
text:
Overview:

Resonetics is a global leader in advanced engineering, prototyping, product development, and micro manufacturing, driving innovation in the medical device industry. With rapid expansion across all our locations, we continue to push the boundaries of technology while fostering a dynamic, employee-centered culture. Our commitment to excellence and continuous improvement makes Resonetics an exciting place for professionals passionate about shaping the future of micro-manufacturing and being part of something bigger.

The Director of Operations is responsible for overseeing daily production activities to drive efficiency, maintain quality, and ensure adherence to company standards. This role leads the development and implementation of organizational strategies, standards, and best practices to achieve world-class operational performance. Additionally, the Director of Production collaborates closely with site and business leadership, leveraging resources and expertise to ensure our products consistently meet customer expectations.

Join Resonetics and be part of a team that’s redefining medical device manufacturing. If you’re passionate about innovation and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we’d love to hear from you.

Responsibilities:

* Lead with a clear view of where the organization needs to be in 1-3 years; communicates strategic direction to employees and how it fits with the day-to-day actions and results being driven.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
* Implement and maintain value streams and SCQDCT management system within the site.
* Provide coaching and support to supervisors and frontline employees to enhance skills and performance.
* Set clear and measureable performance expectations, in line with corporate goals; proactively analyze and manage all relative operations performance metrics.
* Provide timely, accurate and complete reports on the operating conditions of the company.Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and regulatory requirements.
* Ensures alignment with functional leadership (e.g., Engineering, Finance, Quality, Facilities, and Human Resources) on performance management and talent development.
* Ensure the facilities operate within the Company’s ISO and FDA quality management system.
* Participate in the development of the location’s monthly revenue forecasts.
* Monitor and adjust production output and staff levels to support the location’s revenue and cost targets.
* Participate in the development and control of the location’s budgets and quarterly forecasts.
* Working with the senior leadership team, help to develop and implement winning strategies to grow revenues and profitability.
* Ensure the site maintains maximum confidentiality in a highly proprietary operationLead relationship with key intercompany customers to ensure maximum service throughout the value chain.

Required Qualifications:

* BS degree in a technical field, preferably engineering or life sciences.
* Prior experience managing a manufacturing department/organization in a regulated environment.
* Prior experience managing an engineering team.
* Experience working within a Lean, six-sigma organization.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Prior experience managing an independent manufacturing organization.
* Familiarity with contract manufacturing, ISO and FDA quality system requirements, medical device and diagnostics manufacturing.
* Lean, six-sigma green or black belt certified.
* Experience with Nitinol products and processing
* Experience wit Wire and Tube fabrication
* MBA or relevant business management experience.

Physical Demands:

* Ability to work long hours when necessary and to have a presence with a 24/7 operation.
* Domestic travel required

Compensation:

* The compensation for this role is competitive and will be based on experience and qualifications. The anticipated range is $144,000–$204,000.
* Our company policy is that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship. Candidates must already be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for sponsorship now or in the future.

Resonetics offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and financial security of our employees and their families. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance; a 401(k) retirement plan; paid time off (PTO); 10 paid holidays; Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA); life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) insurance; Short-Term Disability (STD) and Long-Term Disability (LTD) insurance; accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity insurance. Eligibility and benefit offerings may vary based on employment status and applicable plan provisions.
